description: This file contains utility functions and classes for error handling, call site capturing, and debugging within the PySpark framework, specifically related to error classes, call origin tracking, and integration with Spark sessions.

classes.name: ErrorClassesReader
classes.description: A class to load and retrieve error class information from ERROR_CLASSES_MAP, including SQL states and error messages.

methods.name: is_debugging_enabled
methods.description: Checks if DataFrame debugging is enabled based on Spark configuration.

methods.name: current_origin
methods.description: Returns thread-local storage containing current call origin information.

methods.name: set_current_origin
methods.description: Sets the current call origin information in thread-local storage.

methods.name: get_sqlstate
methods.description: Retrieves the SQL state code for a given error class.

methods.name: get_error_message
methods.description: Formats an error message by applying parameters to a message template for a given error class.

methods.name: get_message_template
methods.description: Retrieves the message template string for a specific error class or sub-class.

methods.name: get_breaking_change_info
methods.description: Returns breaking change information for an error class if available.

methods.name: capture_call_site
methods.description: Captures the call site information (file, line, function) for debugging purposes, filtering out PySpark and IPython frames.

methods.name: _with_origin
methods.description: Decorator that wraps a function to capture and set call site information during its execution.

methods.name: with_origin_to_class
methods.description: Decorator that applies the _with_origin decorator to all methods of a class, optionally skipping some methods.
